description.value:
Every creature within a 30-foot cube inside range must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become charmed for the duration, rendered incapacitated with a speed of 0 while the charm lasts.

The effect ends early for a creature that takes any damage, or if another creature spends an action to rouse it. Droids and constructs are immune.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Universal Powers, Level 3
